programme.desc: 2025年，適逢民族英雄林則徐誕辰二百四十周年國家主席習近平在福州任職期間，保育了林則徐出生地的一系列遺跡他先後多次引用林則徐苟利國家生死以，豈因禍福避趨之的名句，號召國人把林則徐的民族精神和優秀品格繼承發揚下去ampampampampampltbrampampampampampgt林則徐：虎門銷煙以外是一部由香港電台出品的五集歷史人文紀錄片影片以香港視角出發，跨越三萬公里深入中國多省市（包括澳門廣東湖南福建浙江河南陝西甘肅新疆），更東渡日本，探尋虎門銷煙之外那個更為真實立體的林則徐ampampampampampltbrampampampampampgt林則徐虎門銷煙的壯舉固然永載史冊，但其光輝遠不止於此本紀錄片突破傳統敘事框架，不僅回顧林則徐虎門銷煙的功績，更深入挖掘他作為治水能臣嚴謹學者流放者與思想家的多面人生透過實地探訪專家訪談，並結合AI技術生成動畫重現歷史場景，影片呈現林則徐在禁煙海防水利邊疆開發等方面的卓越貢獻，並揭示其開眼看世界的深遠影響節目以細膩的鏡頭語言和情感敘述，串聯歷史與當下，展現林則徐精神的當代意義，值此民族英雄誕辰二百四十周年之際，向他獻上最誠摯的敬意本片由ampampampampamplt香港電台ampampampampampgt贈播

programme.title: 증시 오늘과 내일
programme.desc: 오늘 장 전문가의 매수종목으로 수익률 극대화, 오늘 장 마감정리와 내일 장까지 대비합니다. 막판 공략주를 통해 갈팡질팡한 시청자들의 마음을 사로잡는 증시 오늘과 내일!!

programme.title: 부당거래

programme.title: 헌트
programme.desc: 낯선 사람들과 함께 의문의 지역에 갇혀 영문도 모른 채 사냥 당하고 있는 크리스탈베티 길핀이 자신들을 사냥하는 주체를 밝히고, 그들을 찾아 복수하기 위해 고군분투하는 이야기

programme.title: 노인을 위한 나라는 없다
programme.desc: 평범한 일상을 보내던 카우보이가 우연히 살인사건에 휘말리면서 벌어지는 이야기를 다룬 범죄드라마. 2008년 아카데미 작품상을 비롯한 4개 부문 수상작

programme.title: 진주만
programme.desc: 1941년 12월 7일 있었던 일본군의 미 진주만 습격을 정면으로 다룬 2001년 여름 헐리웃 최대 블럭버스터. 진주만 폭격에 맞서 싸운 두명의 미 조종사가 1942년 4월 18일 도쿄와 주요 도시를 폭격한 둘리틀 공습Doolittle raid에 참가하기까지를 영웅적으로 그린 대작

programme.title: 범죄와의 전쟁

programme.title: 엑시트

programme.title: 보이스

programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

programme.title: 善德女王
programme.desc: 利用美色掌握宮中權力的美室，一心想成為王后，雖然摩耶王后在她的詭計下死裡逃生，還身懷六甲回到宮中，但摩耶王后懷的雙胞胎卻成就不幸的宿命，因為王室流傳一個預言御出雙生，聖骨男盡，意指王室若生出雙胞胎，將使王室男性斷了精氣真平王深知要是王后生下雙胞胎的事實曝光，一家人將會有無止盡的災難，於是命宮女昭火偷偷將其中一個女兒帶出王宮多年後被拋棄的公主德曼回到新羅，與雙胞胎姐姐天明公主同心協力對抗美室美室企圖用各種手段羅織罪名於德曼公主和天明公主，天明公主於一場追捕德曼的陰謀計畫下意外身亡，原本只想逃出新羅的德曼公主因為天明公主的死開始藉著聰慧的頭腦與身旁各方勢力的協助，最終擊垮政敵美室，成為第一個登上新羅王位的女性

programme.title: 包青天
programme.desc: 宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱包青天，為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調人在做天在看舉頭三尺有神明不畏強權，除惡務盡

programme.title: 紫釵奇緣
programme.desc: 紫釵一錯誤終身，才子佳人各天涯，情深難敵功名路，回首已成舊夢痕根據明代戲曲家湯顯祖的經典名著紫釵記改編而成，講述了大唐年間，歌舞名妓霍小玉風流俠客納蘭東書香才子李益和巾幗紅顏盧靖瀾為首的風騷人物，彼此錯綜複雜的命運與感情糾葛一場指腹為婚的誤會，造成浪漫卻無果的錯點鴛鴦，他們在階級差異與強權壓迫中勇於追求真愛，在宮廷權謀與世俗現實的拉扯中身不由己地被推向命運的叉路，自此展開一段關於愛背叛與救贖的傳奇故事

programme.title: 大漢盛世
programme.desc: 鐵腕定江山，仁德治天下，開創大漢文景盛世氣象西元201年，布衣天子劉邦擊敗西楚霸王項羽，建立了大漢王朝為鞏固皇權，誅滅韓信英布等異姓功臣，並應對匈奴威脅呂后專權後朝政動盪，直至誅呂之亂，性情仁厚長期鎮守代地的劉恒被推立為帝，是為漢文帝文帝即位後，以仁政安民，推行輕徭薄賦與民休息，抑制功臣與諸侯勢力，整頓吏治，重用賢才，推動農業與法制改革，同時安撫邊疆抵禦匈奴在權力與親情間多有取捨，含淚處置親族以穩國本最終奠定文景之治基礎，使漢室走向長治久安

programme.title: 大盛魁
programme.desc: 電視連續劇大盛魁由創業興業歇業三部一百集構成，歷史跨度270年由三個獨立完整的故事構成講述了王相卿張傑史大學等三個赤手空拳創業的故事

programme.title: 錦衣之下
programme.desc: 天賦異稟的六扇門女捕快袁今夏因為一樁案件和性情狠辣的錦衣衛陸繹結下樑子，今夏本以為此生與他再無交集，奈何冤家路窄朝廷十萬兩修河款不翼而飛，今夏奉命協助陸繹一起下揚州查案，替朝廷找回丟失的官銀本是道不同不相為謀，卻因驚天密案聯手兩人從勢同水火到刮目相看再到情難自已，命運的齒輪從此旋轉在一起然而事與願違，今夏竟是當年夏然案的遺孤，背負家族血仇的她與陸繹之間橫生了無法跨越的鴻溝最後，兩個有情人歷經苦難，為救百姓抗倭寇除奸佞，放下家族仇怨，聯手對敵，衝破世俗枷鎖，勇敢地走到了一起

programme.title: 遊戲爆報新
programme.desc: 遊戲爆報新

programme.title: 屍憶
programme.desc: 節目製作人承皓（吳慷仁飾）將和同居許久的未婚妻（謝欣穎飾）結婚，製作的靈異節目也大獲好評，愛情事業兩得意一日他在公園撿到一個紅包後，就不斷夢到一棟詭異的古宅，生活也開始出現奇異亂象，種種線索都指向神秘古宅，究竟古宅藏著什麼秘密？承皓和古宅間有何關聯？前世的怨念，能在今世了結嗎？

programme.title: 于堇：蘭心大劇院
programme.desc: 1941年上海孤島時期，知名演員于堇（鞏俐飾）返回上海，表面上是為了出演她的舊愛譚吶（趙又廷飾）所執導的舞台劇，但這神秘女人的真正的目的是什麼？於此同時，日本少佐古谷三郎（小田切讓飾）也帶著新版的軍事密語到了上海，在飯店遇到了于堇，這個跟前妻有著相似面孔的女人引起他的注意這將是我扮演的最後一個角色隨著話劇即將開演，看似平靜的上海租界將掀起一陣巨浪

programme.title: 執法先鋒
programme.desc: 檢察官夏令正為主持正義懲惡揚善，不惜鋌而走險，以法外手段殺死嫌疑人

programme.title: 危城
programme.desc: 民國初年，時值中國內戰軍閥割據亂世時代，一個叫普城的偏遠城鎮，其治安由普城保衛團暫管由於軍閥少帥曹少璘（古天樂飾）殺害三條人命，普城保衛團團長楊克難（劉青雲飾）於是將曹少帥繩之於法，然曹軍財雄勢大，以強權震懾居民，曹軍上校張亦（吳京飾）得悉事件後，趕來普城取人，遇上多年不見之浪人師弟馬鋒（彭于晏飾）馬鋒路見不平欲拔刀相助，卻面臨正義與兄弟情之抉擇

programme.title: 白髮魔女傳
programme.desc: 武當奇才卓一航幼年結識一神秘狼女成年後的卓一航為人正直，仗義行俠卻屢遭所指大師姐雖對其傾心，他卻毫不動心後因誤入魔教禁地為長髮少女所救而難忘其倩影而欲一統江湖的魔教姬無雙，被同屬魔教的練霓裳所制伏，卓一航在混戰中發覺練霓裳正是當年救他一命的長髮少女，兩情相悅互許終身但武當長老囑卓一航應以大局為重，要練霓裳離去，練霓裳因心傷導致烏髮瞬間全白，正邪終不兩立

programme.title: 白髮魔女傳2
programme.desc: 出身名門正派的卓一航與邪教魔女練霓裳相戀，卻不被長輩諒解，導致練霓裳血賤武當與卓一航決裂後便消聲匿跡卓一航呆守千雪峰，等待優曇花開，再覓練霓裳芳蹤練霓裳在走火入魔後卻練成天下無敵奇功大開殺戒，八派本欲聯合卓一航力抗魔女，但卓一航心如止水，已不再過問江湖之事

programme.title: 我吃了那男孩一整年的早餐
programme.desc: 轟動Dcard的校園純愛故事！項微心視吃為人生最重要也是最療癒的事，她第一次跟學長陶宥全相遇，是在學校的福利社跟全世界的17歲女孩一樣，她想像過各種自己在未來的樣子，而她身邊的陶宥全方琦然張元碩也一樣，故事開始時的他們，並沒有想過這一年竟然會有這麼多事，充滿各種疑問

programme.title: 靈幻先生
programme.desc: 江湖術士茅山明法術不精，經常帶着大寶小寶二鬼騙吃騙喝在為富豪譚百萬驅鬼之時遇到厲鬼，連夜逃至一村莊時村莊遭受邪祟馬賊騷擾，茅山明被保安隊長阿強誤作馬賊抓獲，幸虧道長九叔及時出現才逃過一劫因一場紛爭，大寶小寶被九叔收去，茅山明自此領悟人鬼殊途，決定和二鬼分手，然大寶卻被擅長法術的馬賊虜去

programme.title: 做工的人電影版
programme.desc: 11年前，在一處大型公共工程中，阿祈和阿欽鐵工兄弟檔揮汗上工，與一起上工的昌哥阿全逐漸成為相互關照的好友阿祈發現兒子小傑開始和他疏遠，阿全因租屋問題變得無家可歸，昌哥因為大筆的交通罰單，在阿祈的建議下，尋找律師方淼協助，而愛作夢的阿祈發現憑著他驚人的直覺和運氣，如果能上運來哥主持的實境節目似乎能圓個發財夢，於是拉家人報名闖關拚大獎，搏個出頭天！

programme.title: 魁星踢斗
programme.desc: 金麥基與孟超是警員拍檔，他倆所在的警察局在三十年代曾是日軍的軍營，日本戰敗後多名日軍在此集體剖腹自殺，他們冤魂不散，每逢鬼節就會蠢蠢欲動有得道高人警告盂蘭節這些冤魂會出現，但金與孟不信鬼神，對此不以為然直到他們所抓的犯人蛇仔明在警局的監獄裏變成了殭屍，他們才真的相信有鬼存在，於是一場人鬼大戰在警局裡展開

programme.title: 月亮星星太陽
programme.desc: 三位女子各因不同原因進入歡場工作，但最終都領悟到歡場無真愛的道理

programme.title: 黑幫啟示錄
programme.desc: 尚坤不顧父親的勸阻加入幫派，過著流氓生活當他的老大因詐取幫派的錢而被革除時，尚坤便晉升成了新的老大他夢想著美好的未來，但一名手下卻意外捲入麻煩，不僅把他們全拖下水，連家人也因此過得很辛苦尚坤深感懊悔，掙扎著想擺脫過去，但由於過去的種種行為，他最終只能迎來悲劇

programme.title: 破案天才伽利略：嫌疑犯X的獻身
programme.desc: 一具遭到嚴重毀損的無名男屍在河邊被人發現，負責偵辦的刑警內海薰（柴崎幸飾）請帝都大學天才物理學教授湯川學（福山雅治飾）幫忙在調查的過程中，湯川發現自己的大學故友石神哲哉（堤真一飾）竟牽涉其中，且與死者的前妻花岡靖子（松雪泰子飾）似有牽連而隨著湯川的調查越深入，他對眼前的真相就越難理解，兩位天才棋逢敵手，又將如何接下彼此的挑戰書？

programme.title: 師弟出馬
programme.desc: 永寧鎮的年度採青大會，由正風武館和威義武館角逐賽前正風因大師兄受傷，遂改派師弟阿龍出馬正在奪標之際，龍瞥見威義的獅頭竟是大師兄！比賽終為大師兄所勝龍知大師兄此舉必有其苦衷，故未揭發，惜終為師父所知，師父一氣之下將大師兄逐出師門大師兄投靠無門，終被壞人利用而走上歧途此時，師父亦對自己所為有所覺悟，故命龍出門尋找大師兄，龍是否能不負所託？

programme.title: 法海：白蛇傳說
programme.desc: 藥師許仙採藥途中偶遇修煉千年的白蛇，一人一妖互許終身豈料白蛇卻在兩人飲酒慶祝後現出原形，遭不知情的許仙用法刀刺傷，且負傷離去許仙得知真相後悔恨不已，前往雷峰塔盜取仙草拯救白蛇，卻遭妖靈附身而被高僧法海帶往金山寺服下仙草功力倍增的白蛇怒闖金山寺想帶走許仙，與法海展開一場死鬥

programme.title: 西遊記之大鬧天宮
programme.desc: 玉帝大敗牛魔王後，女媧娘娘為求三界和平，願犧牲自我化身晶石築起南天門，卻遺落了一顆石頭化成孫悟空天資不凡的悟空跟隨菩提祖師修成七十二變，決心成為神仙，卻因桀驁性格被逐出師門，到了花果山自立為王落敗的牛魔王為重返天界，用計煽動孫悟空大鬧天庭，使玉帝不得不率領二郎神等眾仙迎戰，天庭再度陷入混亂之中

programme.title: 西遊記：女兒國
programme.desc: 唐僧師徒途經忘川河，因激怒河神而誤入西梁女界，國有祖訓，將男人視為天敵典籍中更預言，有朝一日，會有東土而來的僧人，帶著一隻猴子一頭豬和一個小藍人闖入其中，而他們到來之日，便是女兒國走向毀滅之時！

programme.title: 賭俠2之上海灘賭聖
programme.desc: 周星祖向賭神拜師已一年，而之前在賭局中輸給星的特功能人士大軍為向星報仇，回大陸找師弟們一起對星發功，結果發生時空倒流，星大軍及三叔均回到1937年的上海星先遇上祖父周大福，兩人投靠上海大亨丁力，星並結識清純女子如夢川島芳子欲奪取上海，與丁相約賭桌上定生死，由法國賭神大戰上海灘賭聖大軍棄暗投明，暗中援助星贏得賭局，並幫助星回到1991年，但因無法帶如夢同行，令星感到無限惆悵

programme.title: 金錢帝國：追虎擒龍
programme.desc: 1973年，香港警察與黑道勾結，貪污巨利，荼毒市民港督終於決定成立廉政公署，由黑白雙煞陳克和白松安組成第一批廉政公署調查員，調查權傾黑白兩道的總華探長徐樂及黑道霸主跛豪，嚴厲打擊香港的地下規則和貪污的大老虎，兩人聯手出擊，出現了打貪成效，但也因徐樂與跛豪決定合作對抗廉政公署，更有不少廉署成員相繼遇害，但陳克不放棄信念，一場正義與邪惡的爭鬥，從此拉開了帷幕

programme.title: 速命道
programme.desc: 開著救護車的小樂曾經是最佳賽車手，卻一場與哥哥阿杰的比試中，讓哥哥意外身亡，因而自暴自棄，直到遇見女醫生慧慧，轉念成為救護車司機，誓言要用速度救人然而一名神秘賽車手地獄貓的主人突然現身，他手握名冊，被挑戰的賽車手最終必然喪命地下賽車，就是一場現代武林，儘管以生命作為代價，仍無法阻擋狂熱者對速度進行宿命般的追逐

programme.title: 巫術
programme.desc: 一位Youtuber和朋友們一起去瑞典一座美麗的湖中小島上度過週末的豪華露營此湖流傳著可怕的傳說，據聞島上住著一位古代瑞典女巫，一名老婦人數百年前因巫術而死，但實際上老婦人仍居住於此當然沒有一位朋友相信這些故事，但他們很快就發現自己被困在小島上無法逃離！

programme.title: 把妹哪有這麼難
programme.desc: 麥克被騙購買了一輛可疑的汽車後，導致他與鄰家女孩凱西的第一次約會計畫破裂，因為他發現自己成為了罪犯警察和瘋狂貓女郎的追擊目標

programme.title: 保鑣沒有假期
programme.desc: 尼克和德瑞克原本計畫度過一個輕鬆的假期，但當一名逃脫自毒品集團的男子僱用他們擔任緊急安全人員時，他們的假期即將展開未知的腥風血雨！

programme.title: 凜冬謀殺案
programme.desc: 罹患阿茲海默症的患者，到底還是不是原來的那個他？萊恩因整日照顧昏迷中的妻子荒廢了警局的工作某日小鎮傳出罹患阿茲海默症的長者遭到謀殺，而這名嫌疑犯竟然就是衝撞妻子的肇逃車主？究竟兇手謀殺患者們的背後有何意義？而萊恩又能否為妻子討回公道？

programme.title: 極限遊戲
programme.desc: 被構陷入獄的凱柏（傑瑞德巴特勒飾）在極不情願下，成為流行文化界的超級英雄：全球數百萬粉絲每週上網爭相看他在科技天才肯尼卡索（麥可霍爾飾）所發明的超暴力線上遊戲天地逃殺中，和其他數百位受刑人，為求活命而真槍實彈廝殺有些人不以為然地斥責這款遊戲是利用高科技來奴役他人的傷天害理行為，而驍勇善戰的凱柏，自然成為他們心目中，唯一能撂倒卡索的關鍵人物

programme.title: 決戰天際線
programme.desc: 勇敢的特種部隊少校蘇坦伊貝爾和才華橫溢的飛行員貝茲卡伊貝爾是一對兄弟，儘管平時意見分歧，但當國家遭到外敵威脅時，兄弟倆仍齊心協力拯救平民的寶貴生命

programme.title: 驚天盜數
programme.desc: 維克多是一名小偷，俄羅斯黑幫成員希望他執行一樁搶案，然而維克多對這群新朋友的銀行搶劫計畫並不放心就在眾人準備下手時，國際刑警組織的特工殺死了黑幫成員並逮捕維克多，而負責搶案的司機毒蟲拉沛多卻在維克多的協助下逃走事實上維克多是名臥底警察，但隨著臥底行動終止而被吊銷職位並面臨調查，在心灰意冷之際，維克多決定沿用黑幫計劃，與拉沛多一起搶劫銀行

programme.title: 我的王子老爸
programme.desc: 吉比的人生完全奉獻給八歲的女兒索菲亞他每天最期待的事情，就是睡前跟女兒分享自己悉心創作的床邊故事；在故事裡的幻想世界，他總是化身英勇的王子，一次次拯救陷入危險的女兒三年後，吉比發現即將進入青春期的索菲亞已不再著迷於他的床邊故事，她開始編織屬於自己的故事，而吉比在這些故事裡越來越不重要為了避免失去在女兒心中的地位，他開始嘗試瞭解女兒的人際關係和內心世界，希望重新成為女兒人生的主角

programme.title: 被偷走的公主
programme.desc: 流浪藝術家魯斯蘭夢想成為一名騎士，偶遇了美麗的公主米拉並墜入愛河然而邪惡的魔法師切諾莫為了達成陰謀，在魯斯蘭的眼前用魔法漩渦劫走了米拉魯斯蘭試圖穿越魔法森林尋找公主，經過一系列奇妙生物的助攻後克服了重重障礙，最終戰勝邪惡魔法，與公主幸福地生活在一起

programme.title: 迫切救援
programme.desc: 在美國與墨西哥相接的邊境四個州之中，德州發生最多起非法移民死亡案件，邊緣城市受到毒品黑幫與人口販賣的威脅也層出不窮一名甫畢業的女孩在畢業晚會回家途中遭到綁架，她的哥哥萊恩必須與時間賽跑，要從專門販賣年輕女孩的人口販子手中救回妹妹，在她被人蛇集團吞噬並消失在這世界之前

programme.title: 寒冬戰士
programme.desc: 密科拉是個和平主義者，希望可以對人類有所貢獻當戰爭在他所居住的烏克蘭頓巴斯爆發，激進分子殺了他的孕妻，將房子夷為平地，他的世界瞬間崩塌從悲憤平復後，密科拉入伍參加狙擊連當他遇見殺害妻子的兇手時，經過一番激戰，雙方陣營兩敗俱傷，密科拉雖被指導員救出，指導員卻不幸身亡此事令密科拉耿耿於懷而深感內疚，當他再度接到新任務的通知時，也已準備好這次要犧牲自己的性命

programme.title: 2047死亡地帶
programme.desc: 西元2047年，地球由聯盟政府執行高壓統治，萊恩是反抗軍組織－綠色戰役的成員，他奉命去收集聯盟政府進行種族屠殺的證據不料這一切被聯盟政府發現，政府派出阿西莫夫上校與菁英部隊追捕萊恩及其組織然而當形勢急轉直下之際，萊恩遇到了屠殺倖存女孩圖瓦格，圖瓦格是否能讓形勢逆轉，與萊恩一同拯救被聯盟政府奴役的世界？

programme.title: 逃離索比堡首
programme.desc: 二戰期間，特雷布林卡集中營發生了越獄事件，索比堡集中營的指揮官發誓，他的集中營絕對不會再發生類似事件但那些被囚禁的猶太勞工，知道自己時日無多，唯一的希望就是逃跑索比堡集中營真實事件改編，榮獲金球獎最佳電影最佳男配角等殊榮

programme.title: 深度壓力
programme.desc: 兩戶農家鄰居，因為其中一家將土地租給石油公司，而使關係變得緊張未料土地一經鑽探，沉睡已久的恐怖怪物自深處被釋放，倉促決策帶來可怕後果！

programme.title: 愛情齡距離
programme.desc: 艾莉絲是一位剛離婚的兩個孩子的媽，在與前夫分居之後，帶著兩個女兒回到洛杉磯開啟嶄新生活她在40歲的生日派對上，認識三個年輕又極具魅力的天菜，他們都恰巧需要暫時居住的地方，艾莉絲便讓三位萌男暫時住進她家其中最年輕的小鮮肉展開熱烈追求，讓艾莉絲再次燃起戀愛的念頭！此時，提著行李箱的前夫突然出現在她家門口，徹底顛覆了她在洛杉磯的新生活

programme.title: 奪寶救贖
programme.desc: 價值五千萬美元的非法鑽石遭竊後，前自由格鬥選手與兄弟必須聯手，從危險的犯罪集團中，救出遭綁票的家人

programme.title: 喋血殺陣
programme.desc: 自昏迷中甦醒的布萊恩發現自己身處偏僻沙漠之中，不僅身受重傷還失去了記憶，四周全是倒臥在血泊中的屍體，還有兩台分別裝滿古柯鹼與數百萬現鈔的小貨車惡名昭彰的毒梟馬提歐緝毒署幹員魯克和貪腐的警長奧森，各路人馬為了私吞這筆鉅款，不惜一切代價殺翻天

programme.title: 滅證大追殺
programme.desc: 一位在歐洲留學的女大生希瑟偶然發現了一個恐怖組織策劃的謀殺案，她作為主要證人處於生命危險之中

programme.title: 上古神拳
programme.desc: 身為唯一的繼承人，他守護著一份古老的印加武術秘笈，與此同時世上最優秀的戰士正在追捕著他，其中也包括了他的兄弟這一切將引發極其血腥的復仇行動，更引起來自世界各地的武術家競相爭奪這本能夠突破人體極限的古老秘笈

programme.title: 終結戰
programme.desc: 一位項上人頭遭到懸賞的年輕美國警察為了替亡師報仇血恨，與一名泰國傭兵聯手合作當他發現自己正與該國最惡名昭彰的冷酷罪犯正面交峰時，他的任務轉瞬之間變得無比凶險

programme.title: 王子鬥惡龍
programme.desc: 著名屠龍人坦拿的小兒子尼基下定決心要像父親一樣征服巨龍雖然父親強烈禁止，但尼基仍踏上屠龍之旅，需要擊敗復活的惡龍才能從魔法世界中返回家園

programme.title: 再見街貓BOB
programme.desc: 在街頭自彈自唱兼賣The Big Issue大誌雜誌的詹姆士，從他遇見流浪貓Bob的那天起，他們就療癒了彼此，不再讓彼此流浪，並展開一段堅定無比的人貓情誼他帶著Bob上街賣藝，而Bob在賣藝期間，也總是靜靜待在詹姆士的琴袋上吉他上，甚至是肩膀上這次，詹姆士將和Bob度過彼此在街頭的最後一個聖誕節，Bob也將再度幫助詹姆士度過最艱難的時光，並讓他了解到聖誕節精神的真諦

programme.title: 前線狙擊手
programme.desc: 1943年末，納粹派出訓練有素的狙擊手進入到前線，帶來了破壞和死亡，被圍困的蘇聯士兵已經堅守保衛了國家兩年年輕又天賦異稟的獵人葉戈爾受到徵召挺身對抗入侵者，雖然年輕又缺乏戰鬥經驗，葉戈爾仍以過人的技能和勇氣，證明自己在前線有能力扮演扭轉戰局至關重要的角色

programme.title: 英雄訣43-44首
programme.desc: 英雄訣43-44首

programme.title: 戴高樂傳奇
programme.desc: 戴高樂是法國著名的軍事家政治家，在二次大戰期間領導自由法國運動，戴高樂改變了二戰結局及法國的歷史1940年5月，法國被德軍攻克新上任的夏爾戴高樂將軍加入巴黎政府，而他的妻子伊馮娜及三個孩子則留在東部就在新上任總理貝當打算向希特勒投降並與之談判時，戴高樂只有一個目的：繼續抵抗德軍伊馮娜和孩子們被迫與數千個法國家庭一起逃離德軍的入侵在彼此毫無音訊的情況下，戴高樂一家是否會淪為法國的犧牲品？

programme.title: 聖保羅炮艇
programme.desc: 1926年的中國，時值軍閥割據與國共內鬥，一艘名為聖保羅的美國炮艇航行於長江流域，其任務是保護在中國動亂地區的美國人民，因而見證了大時代下的中國人民生活本片拍攝於東西方冷戰時期，因政治因素而多於臺灣北部取景，留下不少彌足珍貴的影像

programme.title: 狄仁傑之九層妖樓
programme.desc: 涼州府唐家九層妖樓接連出現恐怖怪狀，還嚇瘋了周邊的葛大爺，令九層妖樓鬧妖事件一時之間傳得沸沸揚揚，人心浮動為安撫人心，狄仁傑先是醫治好葛大爺，又親自前往唐家，向家主唐志遠詢問探查唐志遠卻含糊其辭，神色怪異，引起狄仁傑的懷疑剛離開唐府，便被唐家大小姐唐慕卿的侍女畫兒悄悄塞了封求救信

programme.title: 爆破死亡谷
programme.desc: 二戰後期，已節節敗退的納粹德國為求反敗為勝，希特勒下令全力發展秘密報復性武器倫敦方面由於情報有限，軍方於是啟動十字弓計畫，選派具語言與科學專長的人員訓練為特工，潛入德國地下工廠蒐集情資當一連串的未知武器輪番來襲造成英國軍民一片恐慌，盟軍的一切希望就寄託在這些特工身上！

programme.title: 非誠勿擾3
programme.desc: 笑笑答應秦奮求婚後，因追求公益事業離家十年，研究出智慧型機器人的老范為解秦奮相思之苦，設計了一個外表酷似笑笑並植入二人美好回憶的機器人笑笑送給了他在秦奮逐漸深陷AI笑笑的溫柔鄉時，真笑笑突然歸來，兩個笑笑一個敢怒一個敢言，讓秦奮一個頭兩個大，頻頻被虐三人相處笑料與火藥味十足

programme.title: 外科醫生
programme.desc: 綽號鷹眼皮爾斯和少女捕手約翰的二位上尉軍醫，醫術高超卻玩世不恭，被派至韓國戰場最前線的4077陸軍野戰醫院面對接不完的傷兵手術，一有空就是馬丁尼杯不離手，要不就在直升機坪打打高爾夫做做日光浴，鎮日找機會要惡搞道貌岸然的職業軍醫少校和與他同路的火辣性感護理長火熱嘴唇少校瘋狂的戰場瘋癲的軍醫火熱的護士，就如片尾老兵所下的結語：該死的陸軍

programme.title: 西部殺陣
programme.desc: 前軍人勒邁過去的任務曾撲殺夏安族人，也因此被夏安族首領詛咒，預言他將被自己的孩子殺死勒邁深怕預言成真，開始尋找失散的孩子們，為避免被他們殺死，勒邁先將他們一一殺害，直到剩下最後一個兒子卡爾卡爾本身也是一個不法之徒，受到賞金獵人和警察的追捕勒邁必須設法阻止他的兒子，並終結這場詛咒

programme.title: 戰狼堡壘4：準備行動
programme.desc: 為了接受治療，戰狼部隊反被捲入一場國際陰謀，他們必須和過去的戰友合作執行新的任務

programme.title: 英雄訣45-46首
programme.desc: 英雄訣45-46首

programme.title: 諜報飛龍
programme.desc: 三位懷抱理想的科學家創立銀河黨，欲創造一個和諧世界，他們以控制天氣來恐嚇全球順應理想，若不從便將其港口城市淹沒各國領袖齊聚美國商討對策，其特務卻一一被滅口，而電腦分析出唯一能勝任反恐任務的特務，唯有一名我行我素的麻煩人物：德瑞克弗林特美國總統親自熱線下令，弗林特憑藉一身絕技與高科技秘密武器，最終直搗黃龍摧毀銀河黨

programme.title: 血滴子
programme.desc: 雍正王朝為打壓反清復明勢力，創立特種暗殺部隊血滴子此部隊從小接受專業訓練，擅長操作神祕暗器血滴子，此飛天武器威力驚人，發射直搗目標人頭，因殺人於無形，從未有人見其真實樣貌乾隆年間，反清復明組織牧人信眾萬人日漸強大，首領天狼更是武功高強，嚴重威脅朝廷血滴子隊長冷奉命率領部隊剷除異己，卻不知身陷更大的陰謀之中

programme.title: 狂沙十萬里
programme.desc: 冷血殺手法蘭克神秘復仇客口琴仔美麗寡婦吉兒盜賊頭頭夏安，四人各為不同理由原因來到這處鐵路即將開通的西部荒漠甜水鎮鐵路大亨莫頓為取得鐵道用地，在甜水鎮大興風浪，在現代鐵路西進的歷史洪流中，上演新一輪腥風血雨的美國西部開拓史

programme.title: 失孤
programme.desc: 只有在路上，我才感覺我是個父親1998年老雷年僅兩歲的兒子遭拐，從此下落不明爾後老雷騎著一台綁著尋人啟事的破舊機車，十多年來尋遍中國，途中他邂逅了俊朗的小夥子曾帥，仿佛是命運安排，曾帥竟和老雷的兒子有著相似的遭遇兩人決定結伴同行，一個為想找到失蹤的兒子；一個想找到夢迴的故鄉

programme.title: 摩斯拉
programme.desc: 因為在輻射汙染區發生船難，而意外發現原以為是無人島的神秘小島：嬰兒島當調查隊在島上遭遇危險時，幸得到兩名身高只有30公分的小美人搭救，然而貪婪的人類卻將之捉走並公開表演嬰兒島上的守護神摩斯拉前往日本搭救，人類動用原子熱能砲射擊在東京鐵塔下結繭的摩斯拉，原以為已成功消滅時，摩斯拉卻破繭而出，展動雙翅

programme.title: 危機倒數
programme.desc: 美伊戰爭時期，被派至伊拉克擔任拆彈隊長的詹姆斯雖然經驗老到，在一次任務中卻因他的堅持，意外讓隊友們陷入死亡絕境，小隊中開始出現反彈聲浪不久後的一場突襲任務出現一名自殺炸彈客，詹姆斯才意識到，自己的一舉一動將無法逆轉地改變身邊每一個人的命運；命懸一線的隊員，該如何從全世界最危險的戰地平安回家？榮獲奧斯卡最佳影片及最佳導演等六項大獎

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋雙語版
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘雙語版完
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚不折不撓的品性宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業

programme.title: 雲襄傳
programme.desc: 陳曉攜手毛曉彤闖江湖，智武雙全亂世見真情！！雲襄背負雲台門使命開始於江湖中走盪，因意外結識瀟灑帶勁的俠女舒亞男等其他能力之士而成為好友一同在波譎雲詭的江湖紛爭中成長理解仁德與尋找正義眾人尋覓禍亂天下的陰謀逐漸明朗時，雲襄決定挺身而出捍衛一切，守住天下大義

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 望子成龍！ 都會家庭的高考大作戰 以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻

programme.title: 魔女之城雙語版新
programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 雲襄傳
programme.desc: 陳曉攜手毛曉彤闖江湖，智武雙全亂世見真情！！雲襄背負雲台門使命開始於江湖中走盪，因意外結識瀟灑帶勁的俠女舒亞男等其他能力之士而成為好友一同在波譎雲詭的江湖紛爭中成長理解仁德與尋找正義眾人尋覓禍亂天下的陰謀逐漸明朗時，雲襄決定挺身而出捍衛一切，守住天下大義

programme.title: 被告人

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 慘遭閨蜜心機暗算 朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚不折不撓的品性宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業

programme.desc: 慘遭閨蜜心機暗算 朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚不折不撓的品性宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 羅美蘭化身高年級實習生 道盡女性職場家庭壓力曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手如今成為上司的崔智媛在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎完
programme.desc: 姜素拉化身訴訟女神 離婚怨偶再擦出火花所謂相愛容易，相處難，恩範荷拉已愛情長跑 10 年結婚3年，因男方外遇出軌導致離婚收場專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉，時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題，對她來說前夫只是行走的贍養費原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司被客戶追著跑，窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表，簽下聘用合約面對最熟悉的陌生人前夫恩範，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 異想天開木瓜島完
programme.desc: 歡迎來到木瓜島！這是一個與世隔絕的地方，有著獨特又古怪的傳統，木瓜島的每個孩子都有小牛看護者，除了一個不知怎麼來到島上的孩子－－卡庫佩，經過種種努力，終於得到一隻神經質的小牛蘇格拉底而這對特別的搭檔，將會挑戰木瓜島的傳統

programme.desc: Part two of two. Haunted by the deaths of his wife and daughter, Leo continues his quest to find the man responsible. Harry and Nikki attempt to counsel him as the police infiltrate a gang of identity fraudsters, but when he finally catches up with his quarry he faces a difficult choice between exacting revenge or seeing justice done. Starring William Gaminara, Tom Ward and Emilia Fox

programme.title: Confessions of a Teenage Fraudster

programme.title: Confessions of a Teenage Fraudster
programme.desc: Between the ages of 17 and 21, Elliot Castro managed to commit fraudulent activity amounting to a estimated 2 million. This documentary continues his story. With a trail of crime stretching across several continents as he continued to live life on the run, then 18-year-old Elliot became more paranoid than ever and a stint in foreign jail seemed just around the corner

programme.title: Confessions of a Teenage Fraudster
programme.desc: After four years travelling the world spending fraudulently accrued money, it seems inevitable that Elliot will be deported into the hands of British police, who have put together an extensive case of his crimes. Once again though, he has other ideas. In truth, the one thing Elliot desires as much as freedom is a settled life. But even when he thinks hes found it, with a new home and friends, there is no escape from his trail of lies and deception. Eventually, justice seems set to catch up with him

The documentary hears from their loved ones and the veterans who mentored them, charting their paths from humble beginnings and revealing the personal battles that culminated in a new breed of England players at Euro 2024

The film examines what was it was like for them to be caught in an event they werent able to fully comprehend at the time and which they were still working through years later

programme.title: The Godfather Part II

Michaels story is intercut with flashback sequences chronicling the early life of his father Vito as he makes the shift from immigrant grocery-store clerk to Mob kingpin. Francis Ford Coppolas Oscar-winning crime drama sequel, with Al Pacino, Robert De Niro, Robert Duvall, Diane Keaton, Talia Shire, John Cazale and Lee Strasberg

programme.desc: Seventy-one million years ago lived a teenage Albertosaurus - a faster, nimbler relative of T. rex. She had to earn her place in a deadly, ferocious pack or risk starvation. programme.desc: The Squirrels need to rescue Enid when they see her at the top of the Mighty Sugar Bun Mountain.

programme.title: The Lost Property Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels have just got some new walkie-talkies and are having so much fun with them. Duggee calls the Squirrels to come for some blueberry juice, but as Tag is running, he trips over a car and falls through a secret door in the wall! Communicating through his walkie-talkie, Tag doesnt know where he is. He can see lots and lots of things around him but no one has any idea where this room is in the house!

programme.title: Return of Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A band of ninjas slaughters the entire Wu Dang Clan and frames Du Gu Wu Di, chief of the Invincible Clan, for the deed. Yun masters the silkworm martial arts style and decides to take revenge for the Clan by challenging Wu Di, but is defeated and seriously hurt. Luckily, Master Li saves and treats him, allowing Yun to avoid the ninjas pursuit.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, shes soon framed for her husbands murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain mens life essence. With a Taoists help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: Disciples of the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In the finale of this trilogy, Gordon Liu reprises his famous role, Monk San Te, as he tries to protect Fang Shih Yu, an arrogant youth who gets into trouble with the Qing officials, and nearly lands Shaolin Temple into trouble too.

programme.title: Men From The Gutter
programme.desc: Two very different cops are out to capture a local drug boss. In this sizzling crime thriller, the two cops go about doing their jobs differently - one does everything to the letter of the law and the other just doing whatever it takes to solve crime.

programme.title: The Emperor and his Brother
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later. As it happens, the chef of this organisation is Qianlongs younger brother and they must now confront each other in opposing roles

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yus beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Holy Flame of the Martial World
programme.desc: Yin Tian Chous parents were killed over a pair of flame-shaped blades. He and his sister were rescued, raised, and trained separately by a hero and a villain, each inheriting one of the blades. Sworn enemies at first, they eventually uncover their true identities and join forces to avenge their parents deaths.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a Generals daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: Water Clan Chief is severely wounded by a samurai killer shortly before the annual duel at Tai Lake. He sends his brother Bao Yu on a long journey to find an antidote for him. On the way, Bao Yu encounters Little Princess and falls in love with her, not knowing that she is hiding a secret plot

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his peoples livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin stronghold alive.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: The Daredevils
programme.desc: Corrupt general Wang Li assumes power by killing his superior. The son of the murdered superior befriends four street performers called The Venoms, and they help him take revenge by posing as government officials offering a peace token to the corrupt general. When Wang arrives at a warehouse, he is ambushed by the Venoms!

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer 1M for her baby...

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hons pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child. When she is hunted down herself, Rong hooks up with a former Flying Guillotine member and her martial arts senior to fight back...

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: One-armed Swordsman Fang Kang wants to lead a quiet life with his wife, but when she is abducted by the Eight Demon Swordsmen clan, he is forced to take them on in order to save her.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: Hong Kong rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance! Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer Li Ching, the daughter of a deceased magician friend.

programme.title: Five Superfighters
programme.desc: A kung fu master and his three students lost everything after they are floored by a bully. To take revenge, the students find ways to learn from other kung fu masters and come back six months later to have a rematch with the bully on their masters birthday.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Huns warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time?

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: Southern Swordsman Ting is named The Fastest Sword but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges. Even so, he is forced to fight the Northern Swordsman. Who will win finally?

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiaos spirit is revived to take revenge when the dolls eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Mans father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the teams downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has posttraumatic stress disorder after his wifes death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firms VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: Detective Lin forms a special task force to crack down on violent motorbike robbers terrorising Foshan and expose the syndicate behind them. However, when his pregnant wife becomes a victim during a brutal attack, Lin uncovers a ruthless conspiracy driven by revenge, pushing him into a dangerous battle against criminals with nothing to lose.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tams life. Mas fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfathers fortune with one condition he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhangs custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called Kung Fu Stuntmen. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tians daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian and seek evidence against his gang. After their release, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, as Shan cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Lets Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The legendary Stone Monkey gives hope to a desperate girl by promising to change her fate. Years later, after a fierce battle against the powerful three-eyed God of War, he is defeated and cast into the mortal world. Stripped of his former glory, Stone Monkey must rise again, confront powerful enemies, and fulfil the promise he once made.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husbands death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yis husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the Happy Spinsters Club set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

It is the meeting point of both the highly influential and rising voices, facilitated by host, Tian Wei. programme.title: Enchanted Mansion The Shell Game
programme.desc: While serving as Finlys magical assistant, Archibald gets lost in a spooky mansion. Archibald helps a grumpy hermit crab find a new shell.

programme.title: Olivia And The Babies
programme.desc: After noticing all the great compliments Mother receives on account of adorable baby William, Olivia finds herself some babies of her own: her cat Edwin and her dog Perry. programme.title: Olivias Pirate Treasure
programme.desc: When Olivia and her family go to the beach, Olivia finds what she thinks is a pearl-making oyster. She enlists Ian and Julian to help her find more, imagining that theyre pirates in search of buried treasure. In reality, Father explains that theyve actually found clams: no pearls inside, but great for a clambake!

programme.title: Olivia Acts Out
programme.desc: Its time for the annual school play, but Olivias stuck playing the part of Cow 2, while Francine lands the starring role. Its up to Olivia to make the most of her small part: with a little help from Julian, she choreographs a climactic mooove for herself and has the crowd on their feet.

programme.title: Olivia And The School Concert
programme.desc: The theme of this years school concert is Fantastic Fruits and Vibrant Vegetables, and Olivia couldnt be more thrilled. But poor Julian cant bear the thought of singing his celery song in front of an audience. With a little imagination and some quick thinking, Olivia helps him overcome his stage fright.

programme.title: Meow-Mazing Games
programme.desc: When Gabby, Pandy, and Carlita prepare for the annual Meow-Mazing Games, they encounter stiff competition from the Doodads and must work together to bring home the coveted dollhouse trophy.

programme.title: Chore Score Dew Drop Swap
programme.desc: On Harpers first allowance day, the pets accidentally knock Harpers Piggy Bank over and lose one of her quarters that she was reserving to buy Nicholas an ice cream cone. Now the Dew Drops must scramble to replace it! When the Dew Drops struggle to help their kids with tasks that are outside their usual fairy-bilities, they decide to swap kids for the day, but ultimately learn they re exactly where they need to be because they know their families so well!

programme.title: Full House Gift Express
programme.desc: Nicholas keeps stuffing oversized objects inside Edens fairy home. But it creates a BIG problem when Harpers family wants to visit grandma and the car keys are nowhere to be found! When Harper gets sick, Marcus builds a pulley between their apartments to send Harper treats. But when Qwak, the chipmunk, breaks the pulley, the Dews must step in to keep the treat train running.

programme.title: Fluffy Flufferton
programme.desc: Feline popstar sensation Fluffy Flufferton is performing a concert at the Dollhouse Hotel, and Gabby unboxes tickets to see her! Gabby meets Fluffy and discovers that shes afraid to try new things because she doesnt want to make mistakeswhy mess with perfection? But with the help of the Gabby Cats, Fluffy learns how to fail fantastically and be the most fluff-tastic version of herself. For our Cat of the Day segment, DJ Catnip sings a song about the Dollhouse Hotel.

programme.title: Cakeys Cupcake Cousins
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a tin full of Cakey-like cupcake kitties, she realizes... Cakeys Cousins are coming to visit! Cakey welcomes his Cousins to the dollhouse and leads them through a fun-filled itinerary of activities, but quickly realizes his cousins have an agenda of their own. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Pillow Cat sings a song!

programme.title: Fancy Fifths
programme.desc: When Marty accidentally steals a pair of slippers from a department store, he plans an elaborate heist to return them and learns in the end that its easier to own up to your mistakes than to cover them up.

programme.title: Hedgehog Sitters Club
programme.desc: When a litter of hedgehogs are temporarily relocated to the habitat, Alex, Marty, Melman, and Gloria become their babysitters. After an Adventures in Babysitting-style citywide hedgehog chase, our gangwith a newfound sense of responsibil

programme.title: Little Sisters Tricky Treasure
programme.desc: Kelp and Pixie forget about their little sisters and their plans to hang out. Scallop goes to Unicorn Land and meets Juniper. They play and become friends. The unicorns are eager to play with a new mystery item that washes up on the beach, but what is it? While the other unicorns come up with imaginative ideas of what it could be, Pixie is determined to find out exactly what it is.

programme.title: Crabby Spe-shell
programme.desc: When Pixies pet crab goes into a cave, Kelp uses his knowledge of crabs under the sea to coax him out using dance and rhythm. Scallops special shell is broken, but Kelp transforms the broken bits into something even more special.

programme.title: Catch Me If You Sam Toy Driver
programme.desc: Its Tag and Scoochs first day of Race Cadets and Sam Whippet tells the Cadets that whoever can catch him in a race will be the new team captain. When Mom donates a box of Tags old toys to the new daycare center, Tag decides that the only way to get her box of toys back is to go around town collecting toys to swap out for her toys.

programme.title: Frank and Beans with Chili Little Hound on the Prairie
programme.desc: Beans is nervous that Frank is starting to make a new best friend, so Beans enlists Tag to help him win Frank back. Grandpaw and Grandmaw tell Tag the story of the early days of Pawston. Tags ancestor, Tagatha, built a steam-engine and turned Pawston from a one-house town into a thriving community.

programme.title: Harmony Harbors Holiday Surprise
programme.desc: When the townsfolk decorate the Harmony Harbor holiday tree but lose the treetop star, TZG secretly search for it in the yard of a notoriously scary house. When it transpires the house is not-so-scary after all and belongs to shy inventor Dr. Greenlittle, TZG secretly leads her to the big Harmony Harbor sing-along so that she doesnt have to spend the holiday alone.

programme.title: The Big Sleep-Walk Of Course You Can
programme.desc: When Ian starts to sleepwalk around Harmony Harbor, TZG secretly guides him back to his own bed where he can continue sleeping safely. When Felicia wants to run an obstacle course for the first time but is afraid shell embarrass herself, TZG secretly boosts her confidence by helping with practice.

programme.title: Crash Course
programme.desc: Burple and Winger each injure a wing while theyre with Dak, and only teamwork can get them home. At the roost, Cutter gets stuck in a puddle of goo.

programme.title: Furious Fun
programme.desc: The Rescue Riders have a Dragon Day to show their skills to a young fan, but Aggro skips it to hang out with her new fun -- but reckless -- friends.

programme.title: Gabby, I Shrunk the Kitties!
programme.desc: Gabby and Pandy accidentally get turned teeny-tiny when one of Mercats potions spills. To get back to their normal size, they need to find the right ingredients to make a grow potion, which means going on an itty-bitty search through the dollhouse! For our Cat of the Day segment, Mercat shows us how to make sparkly, mermaid slime.

programme.title: Its Purrsday!
programme.desc: Its Purrsday, the happiest cat day of the year, and all the Gabby Cats have a special purrsday surprise. Gabby and Pandy make peekaboo kitty paper chains with Baby Box, decorate a Purrsday cake with Cakey, Gabby gets a special kitty makeover with Mercat, and everyone sings a Purrsday song with DJ Catnip. For the COTD, DJ Catnip shows us how to make a DJ Catnip purr-stick!

programme.title: Fleshbeast Time Leafer
programme.desc: The Mighty Ones are terrorized by the human baby that runs amuck through the yard, but Rocksy is drawn to its power. Everyone thinks Leaf has gotten loopy, but his theories about time travel might just be what the Mighty Ones need to return to their home.

programme.title: Clickety Clacks Rocksys Thing
programme.desc: Rocksys talent goes to her head when she and Berry accidentally invent tap dancing. Rocksy finds one end of a shoelace and tasks her friends with helping her free it so she can have a thing of her very own.

programme.title: Lucky And The Field Trip Fraud
programme.desc: Lucky is determined to shed her reputation as teachers pet on the class field trip.

programme.title: Lucky And The Shaky Day
programme.desc: When an earthquake takes out the railroad bridge, the PALs must find a way to stop the oncoming train which Jim is aboard

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Worrisome Wedge of the Water Warmongers
programme.desc: Harold and George cant wait to spend the summer together at camp. But not so fast, boys -- your old nemesis Mr. Krupp has a most unpleasant surprise.

programme.title: Night Of The Hunters Pt 2
programme.desc: As Hiccup and Snotlout race to rescue the others from Ryker and the Dragon Hunters, they dont realize Dagur and Heather are working with the enemy

programme.title: Bad Moon Rising
programme.desc: After a strange creature bites Tuffnut, he believes hell turn into a legendary Lycanwing dragon when the moon is full unless his friends can save him

programme.title: Snoutlout Gets The Axe
programme.desc: When Snotlout and Astrid must fly a ceremonial battle axe to a family wedding, they must work together when an Armorwing dragon derails their plan

programme.title: Combustion
programme.desc: Tony is convinced that Layla is deep undercover and tries to talk to her alone to get through to her. Meanwhile, the crew investigates the gangs production of the mysterious formula from the tattoo. When Frostee discovers that the product of the formula is unstable and will explode, Tony has to save Layla, who is driving a whole truck of it!

programme.title: Driving Blind
programme.desc: Now broken out of mind control, Layla goes undercover with the gang, hiding the fact that shes no longer being controlled. The crew is shocked to discover that revered martyr Rafaela Moreno is still alive and is the mastermind behind the mind control plot. Rafaela puts Laylas driving to the test in a wild race against a mystery driver, then takes the rest of the crew hostage just days before Rafaelas dastardly plot.

programme.title: An Echo of Nowhere
programme.desc: Now in Rafaelas custody, the crew works together to break Echo out to retrieve the hauler. Echo makes it into the jungle and must battle a mind-controlled Ms. Nowhere using everything shes learned about spying and survival from the very woman whos out to get her. Meanwhile, Rafaela enlists Frostee to help her develop a non-exploding version of the mind control formula before her plan goes into motion at the favela race.

programme.title: A Cause for The Paws
programme.desc: Po, at the top of his game but lonely, comes across two weasels stealing an earthquake causing gauntlet and tries to stop them, but inadvertently destroys a town. He loses his title as Dragon Master and teams up with Wandering Blade, a knight on a mission from England, to track down the weasels and get his title back.

programme.title: The Knights Code
programme.desc: Po and Blades personalities clash as they track Klaus and Veruca and fight off some of Pos old foes. Blade gets to see Pos kung fu mastery, but doesnt agree to team up with him until she realizes that he accidentally holds the key to finding Klaus and Veruca: he has a piece of the WuGao Gauntlet. Meanwhile, Klaus and Veruca continue on their path of destruction while looking for the mysterious Lotus.

programme.title: The Lotus
programme.desc: Pos moral lines are blurred when he and Blade have to break an untrustworthy hedgehog monk Zhen out of jail to get more information on what Klaus and Veruca stole from the Lotus. They learn from Zhen that there are in fact three more weapons, and Po recognizes one of them from a comic book.

programme.title: Blinkys Day Out
programme.desc: After the events at Gattos Keep Blinky is transformed into a human being and Jim discovers the assassin that is hunting him.

programme.title: The Shattered King
programme.desc: While Jim and Toby search for dates to the Spring Dance the team searches for the Second Triumbric Stone in the marshlands of the Quagawumps.

programme.title: Airheads
programme.desc: When Jim is unavailable to do a simple Trollhunter task Toby and Claire take on the responsibility to prove they can carry their weight... literally.

programme.title: Mothers Day
programme.desc: The arrival of Tronos a bounty hunter with the power to control electricity sparks an investigation by Area 49-B that threatens to expose the Royals alien identities. Meanwhile, Mother watches as the Royals struggle to work together to deal with this new threat.

programme.title: Ill Gotten Gains
programme.desc: When Colonel Kubritz issues a medical quarantine that locks down the high school, Aja and Krel must avoid capture with help from their friends. Meanwhile Vex, Zadra, and Stuart have a run-in with a familiar face.

programme.title: Theres Something About Gwen of Gorbon
programme.desc: When Stuarts larger-than-life ex-girlfriend surprises him with a visit, Aja, Steve, Vex, and Nana join them on a triple date where issues from each of their relationships come to a head. Meanwhile, Krel, Toby, and Eli discover a new passion: Sci-Fi filmmaking.

programme.title: Witch Hunt
programme.desc: With the future at stake, Douxie and Claire cling to the hope that Arthur and Morgana can reconcile. Meanwhile, humans are hunting trolls in the woods.

programme.title: Lady of the Lake
programme.desc: Merlin leads his ragtag crew on a quest to restore Excalibur and save Camelot. Elsewhere, Jim tries to convince Blinky that theyre on the same side.

programme.title: Angerdome Tush Twins
programme.desc: Tip battles an alien as angry as she is at the Boovs Angerspringa festival.Sharzod and Lucy become besties and call themselves the Tush Twins.

programme.title: Sitting On Babies Best Frenemies
programme.desc: Things go very wrong when Tip and Oh watch the Gorg babies at a cheese-themed playlandCaptain Smek pretends to be Ohs friend just to ruin his day.

programme.title: Strutter Sitting Corny-O Chaos
programme.desc: The Strutter siblings hold a yard sale and babysit at the same time. Archibald races for a big prize: a lifetime supply of his favorite cereal.

programme.title: The Chicken Has Landed The Night of the Nibbler
programme.desc: Archibald takes an unexpected trip to outer space. When a yummy recipe goes missing, Archibald P.I. sets out to crack the case.

programme.title: Olivia And The Family Photo
programme.desc: Mother is determined to take the perfect family Christmas photo in the middle of the summer. With the help of a snow machine, Olivia takes it upon herself to bring a little Christmas spirit to the photograph, and to Francines backyard beach party next door.

programme.title: Olivia Goes Camping
programme.desc: Francine comes along reluctantly on Olivias family camping trip, and Olivia cant believe that anyone could be so unprepared for life in the great outdoors. But with a little hiking, bug-catching, and marshmallow roasting, Olivia is sure she can transform Francine from a novice to an expert camper.

programme.title: Olivia The Nature Photographer
programme.desc: After snapping some great photos of her cat Edwin, Olivia thinks shes ready to photograph some real wild animals. She and Julian camp out in the backyard to wait for some, and sure enough they track down a mysterious animal in the bushes. But is it really a wild beast?

programme.title: The Two Olivias
programme.desc: Theres a new girl in Olivias class and her name is...Olivia! Confusion ensues, and Olivia the original Olivia cant believe that she shares her name with another person. After a brief stint calling herself Pam, Olivia eventually decides that a two Olivia town might not be so bad after all.

programme.title: Pandys Birthday
programme.desc: Its Pandys birthday!! The dollhouse is throwing a surprise party for him! Gabby goes room to room preparing all his favorite things for the party, but when the big moment comes, Pandy drops his cake! Gabby consoles him and tells him its even better now, they have smash cake! They all hold up a piece and pose for a picture.

programme.title: The Glitter Guide Piano Panic
programme.desc: When the Dews find out their glitter guide an older Dew Drop is coming to visit, they bend over backwards to make a great first impression, but end up forgetting some of their responsiblities in the process. When a string breaks on Marcus piano before his recital and he cant practice, the Dews must lead Marcus to a new piano.

programme.title: Dew Drops Day Off Up All Night
programme.desc: When the Dew Drops have the day off, they discover their families still need their help when theyre not around. Harper needs a good nights sleep before her first day of Cooking Camp. But when an overtired Nicholas keeps her awake, the Dews must help keep Nicholas quiet, even if it takes all night.

programme.title: Gabby, I Shrunk the Kitties!
programme.desc: Gabby and Pandy accidentally get turned teeny-tiny when one of Mercats potions spills. To get back to their normal size, they need to find the right ingredients to make a grow potion, which means going on an itty-bitty search through the dollhouse! For our Cat of the Day segment, Mercat shows us how to make sparkly, mermaid slime.

programme.title: Its Purrsday!
programme.desc: Its Purrsday, the happiest cat day of the year, and all the Gabby Cats have a special purrsday surprise. Gabby and Pandy make peekaboo kitty paper chains with Baby Box, decorate a Purrsday cake with Cakey, Gabby gets a special kitty makeover with Mercat, and everyone sings a Purrsday song with DJ Catnip. For the COTD, DJ Catnip shows us how to make a DJ Catnip purr-stick!

programme.title: CupKate
programme.desc: Its Kates birthday and everyone in the habitat has something amazing planned- but Melmans worried that his homemadehoof-made gift wont measure up. While on a no-holds barred quest to get Kate her favorite cupcakes, Melman learns the gift doesnt matter, as long as it comes from the heart.

programme.title: Pest Side Story
programme.desc: Gloria becomes determined to earn her Queen of Kindness Kidizen badge and welcomes some free-spirited rats who need a place to stay into the habitat. Despite her discomfort, Gloria encourages the rats to make themselves at home. When the rats play with her special baby tusk at the bottom of her tank, she finally snaps and sends the rats home. It isnt until the gang winds up at the rats nest and Gloria almost takes a slice of the rats special cheese that she learns its okay to say no.

programme.title: Spinny Water Kelps Song
programme.desc: Kelp and his underwater friends race around an obstacle course, but Cruz gets sucked into a whirlpool. As each of them try to rescue him, they are sucked in! Kelp saves them all using his unicorn spark to create bubbles he attaches to seaweed. Kelp helps his unicorn friends create music with their horns and pieces of nature. Ollie is embarrassed by the sound of his horn.

programme.title: Playground Sparkless
programme.desc: Cruz decides to turn the sunken ship into a park. But all his and Kelps fun-crastinating puts the project in jeopardy. Kelp accidentally knocks a boulder into the stream, blocking the flow while trying his unicorn spark. Frustrated by magic, Kelp uses the narwhal way.

programme.title: Chaser And Chewer Recipe For Adventure
programme.desc: Tag and Scooch pretend to be their favorite comic book heroes and help the dogs of Pawston. But when Frank and Beans pretend to be villains its up to Chaser and Chewer to stop the trouble makers and save the day. Its Bring Your Own Bowl Night at the Barker house, and Tag and Grandmaw team up to make Great Great Auntie Eunices Famous Far Fetched Cookies. But the obscure ingredients are hard to find, so they have to team up and go on an adventure.

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Bark Slow, Dog. Slow!
programme.desc: When Tag and Scooch break Gilbers ancient Golden Slipper, they embark on an adventure to a secret cave to retrieve the matching slipper. For community outreach day, the Race Cadets are paired with an elderly resident of Pawston. Its Tag and Scoochs job to take old dog Leo around town for a day of slow, relaxing activities. But when Leo wants to kickbarx, row and skydive, Tag and Scooch try their best to keep up.

programme.title: Rodney the Hero Club Shed
programme.desc: When Rodney accidentally catches Sam when she falls from a tree and starts to believe hes a hero TZG secretly follow him around town to make sure his clumsy hero-ing doesnt go wrong. When Lula and Luis want a clubhouse for the Squasher Fan Club, TZG secretly help fix up the shed in Luis backyard.

programme.title: It Takes a Zenko What a Racket
programme.desc: When various townsfolk report having lost soft belongings, TZG secretly investigates to discover thieving pigeon Yolanda had been building a nest for baby gophers. When Ians lucky badminton racket goes missing, TZG secretly finds and returns it in time for a rematch against his toughest opponent.

programme.title: Grumblegard, Part 1
programme.desc: While the others care for baby dragons at the roost, Dak, Winger, Burple and Aggro come face-to-face with a grumpy old dragon on a dangerous island.

programme.title: Grumblegard, Part 2
programme.desc: The Rescue Riders plan to team up with the Slinkwings when an angry Grumblegard threatens Huttsgalor. But their old enemies may be up to new tricks.

programme.title: Doodlebook
programme.desc: Gabby unboxes a cup of crayons and a coloring book with the same doodle on every page. When she takes it into The dollhouse each of the Gabby Cats sees something different in the doodle and turns it into a uniquely magical drawing. But when CatRat gets stuck inside the book, Gabby and Pandy must go on a doodle rescue mission to save him.

programme.title: Dollhouse Safari
programme.desc: Its time for a safari adventure in the dollhouse! Carlita, decked out like a safari truck, takes Gabby and Pandy on an adventure through the dollhouse as they follow clues to find the mysterious Felis Catus and discover all kinds of other dollhouse wildlife along the way! For the COTD segment, Cakey and Parrot show us how to make adorable safari snacks.

programme.title: Twig Tat The Gnome
programme.desc: After getting advice from the Yard Tree, Twig gets a carve like a tattoo but he gets more and more carves and ends up going too far. Upon finding a giant, offensive garden gnome, TMOs debate whether to destroy it or consider it art.

programme.title: Gherkin Returns This Blows
programme.desc: The 5th Mighty One, Gherkin, visits for the weekend but Berrys perplexed to discover that hes changed. The Mighty Ones get stuck in a vortex created by a leaf blower war between neighbors.

programme.title: Lucky And The Golden Opportunity
programme.desc: When the PALs find gold, things spiral out of control until Lucky and Spirit have to rescue their friends from the bottom of a mine!

programme.title: Lucky And The Lion
programme.desc: When a mountain lion is spotted in Miradero, no one is safe!

programme.title: Scooter Buskie
programme.desc: The worlds worst baby is on the loose and Boss Baby, Tim and the team must find him before he turns the whole neighborhood against babies

programme.title: Cats in the Cradle
programme.desc: When an unexpected kitten shows up on Boss Babys doorstep, they go head to head against the feline enemy

programme.title: Family Fun Night
programme.desc: The Templetons head to a new family restaurant only to run into Bootsy Calico!

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Angry Abnormal Atrocities of the Astute Animal Agressors
programme.desc: Stuck in separate camps, Harold and George unleash a hyperintelligent talking possum to scare the pants off of Krupp. What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Abysmal Altercation of the Abominable Altitooth
programme.desc: Eager to get the campers out of his hair, Krupp orders them to climb Plummet Peak, where a terrifying creature is rumored to reside.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Bizarre Bout of the Beastly Barfilisk
programme.desc: Harold and George dont ask for much -- just a fun scavenger hunt that doesnt include doing Krupps errands. Careful what you wish for, fellas.

programme.title: The Zippleback Experience
programme.desc: After heroes Hiccup and Toothless save Barf and Belchs life, the grateful Zippleback tries to repay its life debt and abandons riders Ruff and Tuff

programme.title: Snow Way Out
programme.desc: Determined to create a key to the Dragon Eye, Ryker heads to Glacier Island to find the dangerous Snow Wraith being protected by the Dragon Riders

programme.title: Edge Of Disaster Pt 1
programme.desc: When Ruffnut is captured by Dragon Hunters, its up to Astrid and Tuffnut to defend Dragons Edge from the invading Dragon Hunter army Dragons Edge from the invading Dragon Hunter army

programme.title: The Patroness
programme.desc: Echo and Ms. Nowhere bust Cisco, Frostee, and Gary out of their cell. But Rafaela has already mind controlled Tony and Layla and taken them to drive for her in the favela race, allowing her to release her mind control formula on the crowd!

programme.title: Tchau, Uggos
programme.desc: Our team battles Rafaelas mind-controlled crowd. They soon discover that Rafaelas true plan is to steal the spy plane. Tony deduces that Rafaela isnt doing all of this for the money - shes doing it for family.

programme.title: The Giant Haboob
programme.desc: Cleve Kelso breaks Rafaela Moreno and a dangerous, cybernetic prisoner named Matsuo Mori from a high-security ice prison. Back in LA, Tony and the crew experience a major shake-up when Echo gets accepted to Ms. Nowheres spy training but Tony is rejected. While Tony is grappling with his identity crisis, Echo struggles to survive spy school, and Ms. Nowhere and Gary disappear in a massive North African storm during their hunt for Cleve. Echo must lead the Toretto crew and finish Ms. Nowheres mi

programme.title: The Legend of Master Long-Tooth
programme.desc: Po and Blade must convince a deceased comic book writers son to give them information about an unreleased comic that may point them toward the next weapon: a whip of fire. However, after the events of 103 Po is now a wanted criminal, so the Emperors Forbidden Company arrives and captures him. Torn between saving Po and the mission shes sworn to complete, Blade flees and abandons Po.

programme.title: The Gateway to The Desert
programme.desc: A mysterious figure helps Po escape the guards, so Po makes his way to a desert market, determined to prove Blade wrong for leaving him behind. But when he accidentally stumbles into Klaus and Veruca, he and Blade awkwardly reunite while giving chase, and work through their differences. But the mysterious figure has followed Po and tries to capture them, clearly a new threat to our team.

programme.title: The Lost City
programme.desc: With a map from the comic book, Po and Blade make the treacherous journey through the desert to the lost city, and once inside they find the guardian of the fire whip, Rukhmini. The mysterious figure, a stag named Colin, forges an uneasy alliance with Klaus and Veruca.

programme.title: Where Is My Mind?
programme.desc: When Pixies attack Arcadia Oak High the students and faculty must fight their greatest fears Jim faces Angor Rot which takes an unlikely turn.

programme.desc: Chip es un nio de 9 aos que prefiere jugar con sus compaeros antes de las clases de fsica y qumica con su maestra Susan. Chip se da cuenta de que el accidente lo ha enviado a un lugar desconocido y no sabe cmo regresar. Unos tomos de hierro, mercurio e hidrgeno, representados como Fer, Merc e Hidro, lo guiarn para ayudarlo a encontrar el camino de vuelta. Chip piensa que tal vez el Dr. No podra ayudarlo a regresar a su dimensin, y va a verlo para devolverle la lente que el cientfico perdi durante el viaje al micromundo. Pero el Dr. No est construyendo la Torre Negra, una poderosa mquina que lo ayudar a esclavizar a todos los tomos del micromundo. Ahora tiene muchos trabajando bajo sus rdenes, y los lanza contra Chip y sus amigos para convertirlos en prisioneros y arrebatarles la lente. Al escapar, Chip cae en una corriente elctrica que lo transporta muy lejos.

programme.desc: Adisty, a beautiful young woman who serves as the backbone of her family, nearly becomes a sex worker to pay off her familys debts. programme.title: CAHAYA TERINDAH EPS 113
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Indah Ranty Maria and her struggle to find her biological family after discovering that she was adopted. She runs away to Jakarta from her adoptive father Jamal, who intends to sell her, and ends up working for the Hendardi family, where she faces romantic conflicts and emotional mysteries from her past.

programme.title: TURUN RANJANG EPS 66
programme.desc: Albi Samuel Zylgwyn is forced to marry his sister-in-law, Naza Rachquel Nesia, at the request of his father-in-law, Wira. This decision is made for the sake of caring for baby Zia Faradilla Yoshi, Albis wife, who falls into a coma after giving birth. This pressured marriage becomes difficult for both Albi and Naza, as they were previously in love with other people.

programme.title: TERIKAT JANJI EPS 66
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Davina, a conglomerates daughter who falls into poverty after being betrayed. She is forced to pretend to be in a relationship with Sena, a ketoprak street vendor. This fake relationship, meant to protect her reputation, becomes complicated when Sena is actually an undercover intelligence agent on a mission tied to his pastfurther intensified by conflicts involving a stepmother and past betrayals.

programme.title: 灼灼韶华Wild Ambition Bloom
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人重诺守信的女商人This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. programme.title: 他从火光中走来Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队老中青三代消防员们在火灾地震空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进

programme.title: 大泼猴The Legends Of Monkey King
programme.desc: 天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

programme.title: 天地剑心Sword and Beloved

programme.title: 现在很美丽Its Beautiful Now
programme.desc: 此剧讲述在回避恋爱和结婚的时代，李家三兄弟为了占据家庭长辈们留给他们的公寓而寻找伴侣的故事李庆哲是李家的祖父和精神领袖，年纪轻轻就成了鳏夫 在他最低谷的时候，收养了旻昊 与庆哲一样，旻昊和妻子都寄望于他们三个长大成人的儿子，三个体面的年轻人，都有一份不错的工作 庆哲向他的孙子们提出了一个提议， 第一个结婚的人会得到一套公寓 贤才是三个男孩中的第二个，是一名律师 润才是一位在该地区享有盛誉的牙医 秀才一边在包裹服务公司工作，一边为公务员考试做准备 三兄弟谁先结婚？

programme.desc: 南飞和家宜这对好友都面临婚姻的考题：南飞的恋人陈放对婚姻犹豫不决而未能离开前妻；家宜在结婚前夕突然明白婚姻应该为爱情而非安全感南飞于是放下工作与陈放，到贫困地区帮助弱势的一群找回自信家宜与焦岳在携手进行房屋改造中产生微妙的感情千回百转，南飞与陈放家宜与焦岳，终于看清了自己的内心，收获婚姻与爱情，领悟了美好生活的真谛

programme.title: 爱情有烟火Love Has Fireworks
programme.desc: Wang Ruohai ends the relationship. After Li Yifei rescues Qian Fei from harassment, she faces work setbacks, rents out her spare room to ease her mortgage, and finds her new tenant is Li Yifei.

programme.title: 卧底娇娃Pretty Dangerous
programme.desc: 新型毒品粉精灵在城市蔓延，卧底警察潘奕风为彻底摧毁毒品网络，与另两名女性组成卧底小组三人分别擅长推理武术与伪装，以参加女团选秀为掩护，潜入犯罪组织在执行任务中，她们面临身份暴露的危险，但逐步揭开更大的幕后势力故事融合卧底动作与喜剧元素，在轻松与紧张交织中呈现一场惊险的缉毒行动As a new drug Pink Spirit spreads across the city, undercover officer Feng and her all-female team go undercover as girl group contestants to infiltrate a drug syndicate led by a philanthropic couple, only to uncover a larger criminal conspiracy.

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖Our Town, Her Time
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.title: 百味人生Bittersweet Destiny

programme.title: 绝命法官Justice Is Mine
programme.desc: 在二十世纪九十年代初的濠港，法官秦誉与高级督察唐萱二人曾联手将社团头目韩奎龙成功定罪然而秦誉之子意外撞伤韩家长子后，他陷入法理与亲情的两难抉择，最终竟选择伪造证据，为掩盖真相不惜伪造证据嫁祸他人，从法律的守护者坠落为规则的挑战者，将罪责嫁祸给一名偷车少年随着唐萱深入追查这起案件，官商勾结的暗流警界内部的腐败，以及多桩陈年旧案的隐秘关联也逐渐浮出水面，勾勒出一幅复杂的年代罪案图景Qin Yu, who used to be an upright judge, covered up the truth that his son caused an accident and injured the son of a gang leader in a traffic collision. To avenge his son, the gang leader stirred up a storm of bloodshed.

programme.desc: 以弘扬中华优秀传统文化为宗旨，以传统村落为载体，以生活化的故事为依托，以乡愁为情感基础，以优秀的传统文化为核心，展现传统村落的自然环境人文景观民风民俗乡土之物文化积淀等，梳理传统村落的历史发展脉络，聚焦海内外华人记忆中的乡愁，深入挖掘和阐述中华优秀传统文化的时代价值

programme.title: 他从火光中走来Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队老中青三代消防员们在火灾地震空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进

programme.title: 天地剑心Sword and Beloved
programme.desc: 王权富贵是王权弘业和东方淮竹的儿子，是王权世家实力最强者被家族作为道门兵人培养的王权富贵，生活没有自由，而清瞳本来是毒娘子安排到王权家打听情报的间谍，和王权富贵结识后，在富贵的帮助下恢复了自由同时王权富贵内心渴望自由憧憬天下大同的信念亦被逐渐点燃，经历万剑穿心，王权富贵带着清瞳离开王权山庄，走上了自己所悟之道Wang Quan Fu Gui is the son of Wang Quan Hong Ye and Dongfang Huai Zhu, and the most powerful member of the Wang Quan family. Trained as a Daoist soldier, Fu Gui lived a life without freedom. programme.title: 奔跑吧特别篇 5Keep Running Special Season 5
programme.desc: 奔跑吧特别篇 5着重于中国一些偏远和少为人知的地点城市，通过创新游戏设置，增加艺人与当地民众的互动，同时激发大众对奔跑的渴望对温暖的传递和对美好的追求，以综艺化的特色表达传递正能量节目还是由奔跑吧固定MC班底 - 超人气大卡艺人继续担纲主持任务

programme.title: 大泼猴The Legends Of Monkey King
programme.desc: 天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. programme.title: 现在很美丽Its Beautiful Now
programme.desc: 此剧讲述在回避恋爱和结婚的时代，李家三兄弟为了占据家庭长辈们留给他们的公寓而寻找伴侣的故事李庆哲是李家的祖父和精神领袖，年纪轻轻就成了鳏夫 在他最低谷的时候，收养了旻昊 与庆哲一样，旻昊和妻子都寄望于他们三个长大成人的儿子，三个体面的年轻人，都有一份不错的工作 庆哲向他的孙子们提出了一个提议， 第一个结婚的人会得到一套公寓 贤才是三个男孩中的第二个，是一名律师 润才是一位在该地区享有盛誉的牙医 秀才一边在包裹服务公司工作，一边为公务员考试做准备 三兄弟谁先结婚？

programme.title: 卧底娇娃Pretty Dangerous
programme.desc: 新型毒品粉精灵在城市蔓延，卧底警察潘奕风为彻底摧毁毒品网络，与另两名女性组成卧底小组三人分别擅长推理武术与伪装，以参加女团选秀为掩护，潜入犯罪组织在执行任务中，她们面临身份暴露的危险，但逐步揭开更大的幕后势力故事融合卧底动作与喜剧元素，在轻松与紧张交织中呈现一场惊险的缉毒行动As a new drug Pink Spirit spreads across the city, undercover officer Feng and her all-female team go undercover as girl group contestants to infiltrate a drug syndicate led by a philanthropic couple, only to uncover a larger criminal conspiracy.

programme.title: 夏日奇妙书My Marvellous Fable
programme.desc: 实习编辑冯天蓝加入出版社的第一份任务就是去催畅销作家王葡萄的稿件，而她交稿的条件就是让冯天蓝从北京开车送她回老家琼海！在回乡的旅程中，王葡萄开始说一些真假参杂的故事，冯天蓝在整理书稿中拼凑出了王葡萄的人生，而王葡萄也在创作中反思自我两个心中有伤的人展开了互相治愈的浪漫奇幻之旅

programme.title: 爱情有烟火Love Has Fireworks
programme.desc: Li Yifei helps Qian Fei after her flat is flooded. A misleading photo scandal costs her job, both relationships collapse, and a mistaken rescue photo draws the reluctant roommates closer.

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖Our Town, Her Time
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia Season 2
programme.desc: The wilds of Zambia are a tough place to live. Here, many animals must come together in groups to help defend territory, protect offspring, find food and overcome predators.

programme.title: Into the Wild Colombia Season 1
programme.desc: Growing up in the rainforests in the heart of Colombia, a young capuchin monkey has to master his climbing skills, learn how to find food and learn to distinguish friend from foe.

programme.title: Animals Like Us Season 1
programme.desc: Discover why it takes a village to raise lion cubs in Kenya and sniff out the mating strategy of fragrant lemurs in Madagascar. Cut a rug at a honeybee dance party, then listen up as a forked-tailed drongo tricks other birds out of their dinner.

programme.title: Animals Like Us Season 1
programme.desc: Marvel at the toothy fish that help sharks maintain their pearly whites and discover the signature calls of dolphin families. Examine capuchin monkeys nut-cracking stone tools, get the warm fuzzies when giraffes snuggle, and meet a meerkat mobster.

programme.title: Airborne Season 1
programme.desc: Check in with animals who are winners at the aerial mating game. Take flight with a bee crafting a custom love potion, watch a draco lizard soar to fend off rivals, and witness the graceful pas de deux that bonds a pair of Japanese cranes for life.

programme.title: Surviving the Amazon Season 1
programme.desc: Every year, more than 200,000 monkeys in Peru are trafficked illegally. Almost all are babies. Watch as these little ones learn to survive without their moms and try to make new friends along the way.

programme.title: Alaskan Summer
programme.desc: Nearly 20 hours of sunlight a day feed the season of abundance. Warmth unlocks water from the glaciers, ice caves and waterfalls. The water crashes into countless streams of the Inside Passage, feeding forest and wildlife alike. From June to August, Alaska becomes a paradise for its wildlife.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack Season 1
programme.desc: Feel the heat as rising temps mean that water is getting scarce. The Manzi pack must stand alongside predators to hydrate at a remaining precious water spot. Hunt with Wekas pack to feed the pups, and watch the Stork Colony thrive against all odds.
